attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Pennsylvania state income tax calculation. Implements flat 3.07% tax on 8 classes of income. NO standard deduction, NO exemptions. ALL retirement income excluded. Per 72 P.S. § 7302-7303 (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix:
"Pennsylvania Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.pa_taxable_compensation xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_interest xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_dividends xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_net_profits xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_gains xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_rents_royalties xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_estate_trust xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_gambling xdef 0.0 /result.pa_total_income xdef 0.0 /result.pa_tax xdef
0.0 /result.pa_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0.0 /result.pa_social_security_exclusion xdef 0.0 /result.pa_pension_exclusion xdef 0.0 /result.pa_ira_exclusion xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate PA Class 1: Compensation (W-2 wages excluding military retirement)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay 0 gt { result.military_retirement_pay /result.pa_military_retirement_exclusion xdef "PA military retirement exclusion: $" result.pa_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if
result.total_w2_wages result.pa_military_retirement_exclusion sub 0 max /result.pa_taxable_compensation xdef
"PA Class 1 Compensation: $" result.pa_taxable_compensation cvs strconcat " (W-2: $" strconcat result.total_w2_wages cvs strconcat " - Military: $" strconcat result.pa_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate PA Class 4: Net Profits from Business (Schedule C)
Calculate PA Class 5: Net Gains (Schedule D Capital Gains)
Calculate PA Class 6: Rents and Royalties (Schedule E)
Calculate PA Class 7: Estate or Trust Income (K-1)
Calculate PA Class 8: Gambling and Lottery Winnings
Exclude ALL retirement income (Social Security, pensions, IRA)
Sum all 8 PA income classes to get PA total income
action_details.action_postfix:
result.pa_taxable_compensation result.pa_taxable_interest add result.pa_taxable_dividends add result.pa_taxable_net_profits add result.pa_taxable_gains add result.pa_taxable_rents_royalties add result.pa_taxable_estate_trust add result.pa_taxable_gambling add /result.pa_total_income xdef
"PA Total Income (8 classes): $" result.pa_total_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Apply PA flat tax rate of 3.07% (NO deductions, NO exemptions)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.pa_total_income result.pa_tax_rate mul /result.pa_tax xdef
result.pa_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"PA tax calculated (3.07% flat): $" result.pa_tax cvs strconcat " (on $" strconcat result.pa_total_income cvs strconcat " - NO deductions or exemptions)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
"Pennsylvania Tax Calculation Completed" job.audit_trail swap addto
